capabilities: Aggregate markdown checkboxes from any file into a task dashboard
Automatically plan days from tasks in daily notes
Track task statuses and customize status symbols
Filter tasks with quick filters and today/week views
Show the active top task in the status bar
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's core task list support has no dashboard for planning days, tracking statuses, or highlighting one top priority task.
summary: Bullet journal–inspired task manager that aggregates markdown checkboxes from the vault into a dashboard with day planning and a top-task indicator.
